title: Imports and Exports Control Amendment Act 1997

sections.shortTitle: Imports and Exports Control Amendment Act 1997
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXXVII of 1997
ACT XXXVII of 1997
IMPORTS AND
EXPORTS (CONTROL) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997.
An Act further, to amend the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, 1950
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 6th December, 1997]
F.9(46)/97-Legis. dated
6-12-1997.--------The following Act of Majlis-e Shoora (Parliament)
received the assent of the Acting President on the 3rd December, 1997, is
hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This act may be called the imports and Exports (Control)
(Amendment) Act, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Imports and Exports Control Amendment Act 1997
sections.description:
Amendment of section 5, Act XXXIX of 1950

ACT XXXVII of 1997
ACT XXXVII of 1997
IMPORTS AND
EXPORTS (CONTROL) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997.
An Act further, to amend the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, 1950
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 6th December, 1997]
F.9(46)/97-Legis. dated
6-12-1997.--------The following Act of Majlis-e Shoora (Parliament)
received the assent of the Acting President on the 3rd December, 1997, is
hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 5, Act
XXXIX of 1950.----In the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, 1950 (XXXIX of
1950), the existing section 5, shall be renumbered as subsection (1) of that
section and thereafter, the following subsections shall be added, namely:--
"(2) If any person
contravenes any provision of any order made or deemed to have been made under
this Act or the rules, schemes or policies made thereunder or makes use of an
export licence otherwise than in accordance with any condition subject to which
it was granted, the Federal Government, or any officer authorised by it, tray
suspend, adjust, deduct or cancel the whole or, as the case may be, any part of
export quotas whether granted to or acquired by such person on the basis of
performance, purchase or by any other means whatsoever, and suspend or as the
case may be, cancel the export registration of such person.
(3) No order under subsection (2)
shall be passed unless the concerned person has been given an opportunity of
being heard.".
